title: REMOTE DOESN'T WORK!
text:
REMOTE DOESN'T WORK!. After removing the plastic sheet AND replacing the battery - the remote just doesn't work.
Would like to get a new remote - I hate to have to send the entire thing back to get a working remote!

product_metadata.title: GreenTech Environmental pureFlow QT7 Bladeless Fan - Desk Fan for Bedroom, Home Office - Unique 90 Degree Vertical and Horizontal Oscillating Fan with Remote, Energy Efficient and Whisper Quiet
features: Keep Yourself Cool and Comfortable: The pureFlow QT7 is an eye-catching fan uniquely designed to circulate air with peak power, performance, and proficiency. Its 90 degree vertical and horizontal oscillation circulates air throughout the entire room. The assembled product dimensions are 12.75” H x 10.50” W x 10.63” D, and the total weight is 6 lbs.

Quiet and Powerful: Built to cycle more air quickly than traditional fans, your room temperature stays consistent and comfortable throughout the day. Run it alongside your air conditioner or by itself. Operates at a whisper-quiet 13 decibels, providing a calm and peaceful white noise.

Customize Your Comfort: The pureFlow QT7 personal fan features 12 individual fan speed settings, offering airflow from a gentle breeze to a steady wind and everything in between. Easily control the speed and oscillation from the comfort of your seat with the included remote.

Energy Efficient: This portable fan is designed to decrease power usage. It uses as little as 2 watts and provides twice the coverage of a traditional fan, providing a flow of smooth air that's distributed evenly for up to 30 feet. Features an auto shut-off timer that operates for up to 9 hours.

Custom Solutions for All Indoor Air Issues: Greentech creates indoor air solutions across many tough environments. Because there’s no “one-solution-fits-all” for indoor air purification, we offer a complete line of commercial products to fit all air purification challenges.
